purpose: Sanitized regression corpus for workflow convergence and host launch reliability.

incidents.symptom: A fresh run, state root, or review package restarts the repair counter.
incidents.rootCause: Repair accounting was stored only inside one run and package.
incidents.prevention: Bind repair waves to a repository campaign ledger outside run state and reject work after the campaign budget is exhausted.

incidents.symptom: A host preflight exits before the evaluator starts.
incidents.rootCause: A shell wrapper assigned a reserved zsh variable.
incidents.prevention: Use the Node formal evaluator launcher without shell-local parsing.

incidents.symptom: The long-suite check detects its own launcher command.
incidents.rootCause: A process regex scanned literal command text from its own shell ancestry.
incidents.prevention: Parse the process table in Node and exclude only the current process ancestry by PID.

incidents.symptom: The Mac lid parser returns an empty value.
incidents.rootCause: A GNU-style expression was used with BSD sed.
incidents.prevention: Inspect complete ioreg bytes in Node with exact string matching.

incidents.symptom: A successful host probe becomes exit 141.
incidents.rootCause: A short-reading grep process closed a pipe while pipefail was enabled.
incidents.prevention: Capture bounded command output first and parse it without a shell pipeline.

incidents.symptom: A preflight cannot find rg or mkdir on a valid host.
incidents.rootCause: The wrapper assumed one platform-specific binary path.
incidents.prevention: Use Node filesystem APIs and resolve required executables from a fixed allowlisted PATH.

incidents.symptom: Every fixture using mkdtemp fails with ENOENT.
incidents.rootCause: TMPDIR was bound to an absent directory.
incidents.prevention: Exclusively create and stat the parent, state, cache, and tmp directories before launch.

incidents.symptom: Child fixtures cannot spawn git or gh.
incidents.rootCause: The evaluator replaced PATH with a set that omitted approved provider tools.
incidents.prevention: Resolve git and gh before launch and pass one fixed Homebrew plus system PATH to the entire evaluator.

incidents.symptom: Publication cannot bind the process incarnation.
incidents.rootCause: The evaluator ran without host capability required for boot and process identity probes.
incidents.prevention: Fail during formal preflight unless host sysctl and power identity probes succeed.

incidents.symptom: Infrastructure replacements repeat indefinitely for one exact SHA.
incidents.rootCause: Attempt accounting was encoded only in conversation coordination and disposable launch paths.
incidents.prevention: Persist an exact-SHA attempt ledger and allow one primary plus at most one classified infrastructure replacement.

incidents.symptom: A reviewer returns review-not-executed without inspecting the diff.
incidents.rootCause: The transport applied the final JSON schema to commentary and tool-call messages.
incidents.prevention: Do not pass a model-time output schema; capture the final message and validate it independently.

incidents.symptom: A PASS covers the local branch delta instead of the immutable package range.
incidents.rootCause: The reviewer inferred scope from the current branch rather than the frozen BASE..HEAD manifest.
incidents.prevention: Verify the exact Git path set before launch and require complete BASE..HEAD scope coverage in the final result.

incidents.symptom: A reconciliation race sometimes misses the expected concurrent mutation.
incidents.rootCause: The fixture scheduled the mutation on the same event loop as a blocking lifecycle.
incidents.prevention: Run the concurrent mutation in a separate operating-system process.
